_comment: Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/ReverberatoryRoaster/tools/make_shape.py. Every element was made for the Seraph Horizons mod. Both levels' parts are in this one shape (level 2's step grate, stoker, doors shut and output in place of level 1's flat grate and well cover, doors open and discharge door shut): a renderer draws what is fitted. Texture codes the renderer sets: 'brick' (the furnace's brick type's, from the rig's bricks), 'pipecopper' or 'pipelead' (the pipes' metal, one part each). The burning bed ('ember') glows. Keep element names when editing: the rig finds its parts by them.
